title: Epsom (Guild Living Epsom): fire strategy covering letter for a fire-engineered later-living development (planning inquiry)
jurisdiction: England, UK (Epsom and Ewell, Surrey), filed in the council's planning inquiry 'additional information' folder. COMPARATIVE NON-ALBERTA RECORD; no Alberta applicability asserted.
code_edition: Building Regulations 2010 (as amended). BS 9991:2015; BS 9999:2017; HTM 05-02:2015; BS 7974:2019. Approved Document B (2019, incorporating 2020 amendments) stated as the latest guidance followed.

facts.text: One-page letter from a fire engineering consultancy (Hoare Lea) to Guild Living, headed 'Re: GUILD LIVING EPSOM - FIRE STRATEGY', reference LET-1920260-2A-CR-20210824-GL.

The development 'provides a variety of later living residences and on-site facilities'. The fire strategy is 'designed to comply with the functional requirements of the Building Regulations 2010 (As Amended) as this is a fire engineered building'.

Guidance followed: BS 9991:2015, BS 9999:2017, HTM 05-02:2015 and BS 7974:2019. Where those are superseded by Approved Document B (2019, incorporating 2020 amendments, including external walls and residential sprinklers), 'the latest guidance has been followed'.
'The evacuation strategy outlined in the fire strategy will be supported by the management plan which will be produced by the building operators and conditioned as necessary.'
The letter attaches no drawings or calculations. Its reference 'LET-1920260' matches the project number 19/20260 on the Stage 2 draft report, which is a separate file in this set (H16-007).
